scope: Native structural projection of a qualified orthodox-standard rules trace into the existing common composition DAG; not an independent rules engine or PLAYING source admission.

input.squares: a1=0 to h8=63, rank-major; no square=64
input.positions: 64 piece codes, side to move, four orthodox castling rights, legally available en-passant target
input.moves: actual piece from/to squares, optional promotion kind, ordinary/castle-king/castle-queen/en-passant form
input.partition: contiguous per-line position and move ranges exactly cover the batch
input.authority: The native qualified Board adapter must validate each legal move and derive EP availability from actual legal moves. The planner validates exact transported board deltas; it cannot certify legality.
input.raw_observations: Provider EP, FEN/SAN/LAN, clocks, reversible ply counts, plies since setup, repetition/search counters and source/player/event evidence are outside this planner and must remain available from their observation owner.

identity.kernel: existing ordered child-ID/multiplicity BLAKE3 witness and public prefix; no new hash domain or chess ID generator
identity.semantic_tags: Actual admitted content children: Chess_Position, Chess_Piece, Chess_Square, Chess_Move, Chess_Line. Field labels and their ordered values are explicit content.
identity.position: Repetition-normalized legal-move state only. Board, side, castling rights and actual legal EP participate. Fifty-move/repetition-history/search equivalence is not claimed.
identity.move: Piece action with side/kind, actual source/destination, optional promotion and special form. Ordinary capture context is retained by adjacent positions.
identity.line: Chess_Line followed by P0,M0,P1,...,Pn, exactly ordered. Equal positions/actions are shared; convergent endpoints cannot collapse distinct histories.
identity.numerals: Existing canonical number tag, shared with Highway/physicality reflection
identity.recipe: The recipe fingerprint identifies the planner/physicality generation; it is not a salt for canonical content identity.

replay.native: A LINE reconstructed from its actual known canonical children must retain its entity witness and physicality under the same recipe/geometry.
replay.occurrence: Every request has flags=0. Repeating a LINE batch does not create PLAYING or independent evidence.
replay.persistence: Use the existing active atom provider and composition PostgreSQL presence/persistence owner; no chess-specific store.
replay.future_acceptance: Actual admitted-floor deposition, exact stored readback and new-backend replay remain required before claiming durable chess admission.

nonclaims: all chess variants or nonorthodox castling setups
